Dr Paweł Rzeszuciński, a member of the Forbes Technology Council, is the author of over 30 publications and patents in the field of broadly defined data analytics. He obtained a Master's degree in computer science from Cranfield University, after which he moved to the University of Manchester, where he obtained a PhD for the project for QinetiQ related to analytical solutions for the diagnosis of helicopter gearboxes.

After returning to Poland, he worked as Senior Scientist at ABB Corporate Research Center and Senior Risk Modeler at Strategic Analytics for HSBC. He is currently working as a Chief Data Scientist at Codewise.
